name: hermit-wallet-worklet
description: The wallet worklet (Tether WDK EVM inside Bare): creates, seals, restores and reveals the seed for SL-38. Not a workspace package; the Expo config plugin (or build.mjs as a fallback) packs it for react-native-bare-kit 0.16 (Bare 1.33.4). Stable testnet only.
